answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 5095 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to take any items on instalments and paying more money to that item.because its not possible for me to pay the whole amount at a time, please reply. Question: Is it permissible to take any items on instalments and paying more money to that item.because its not possible for me to pay the whole amount at a time, please reply. Answer ID: 5095 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 314/314=M/1429) It is permissible to purchase an item on instalment with additional price provided the price is fixed at the time of transaction. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
